name: tehw0lf-claude-skills
description: Custom Claude Code skills by tehw0lf

plugins.name: nx-migrate
plugins.description: Migrate an Nx monorepo to the latest Nx version with automatic conflict resolution and PR creation.

plugins.name: trivy-fix
plugins.description: Fix Trivy CVE findings from SARIF files across all relevant files in the codebase.

plugins.name: prune-branches
plugins.description: Delete local git branches whose content already landed on the default branch, with squash-merge detection and a dry-run preview.

plugins.name: setup-workflows
plugins.description: Set up tehw0lf/workflows reusable CI/CD in a repository: detect the project type, read the live input list from the orchestrator, and generate a validated caller workflow.

plugins.name: inbox
plugins.description: List everything on GitHub that a task can be derived from across all of an owner's repositories: security alerts, failing default branches, open PRs, dependency PRs and issues, with a one-line summary at session start.

plugins.name: pr-review
plugins.description: Independent, read-only review of one pull request before it is merged: verifies the PR first-hand, classifies every finding as blocking, fix-in-PR or follow-up and writes the verdict as a comment file.

plugins.name: work-issue
plugins.description: Work one GitHub issue: a planner (Opus) first reads it and the code and posts an implementation plan or the open owner questions on the issue, then the worker implements the current plan to an open pull request, or unsupervised through independent review and merge.
